changed.name: KitRequestCard
changed.change: Becomes the one answer card for OC1 permissions/questions, OC2 forms, choices blocks, AI Team gates and external-task replies: kind, who (agent + server), in-place common answer (Allow once/Reject, single choice with Undo, Something else field), phases waiting/sending/answered/answeredElsewhere/expired with an "answer received" collapsed row and KitReceipt, since escalation, Details via showKitRequestSheet (KitSheet + RequestRoutes). Always allow moves into the sheet as a risk-scoped switch.

platform (no UI).why: Shortcuts, intents and routing: no visible part

special surface.why: One-off surfaces (terminal, camera, graph, rail, meter, stock pickers)

rules: Undo vs confirm vs neither: if a mistaken tap loses nothing, act and show the result (start, harmless restart, settings, choices, copy, refresh); if the app can put it back, act then Undo (archive from swipe AND menu, restore or delete a local saved prompt, withdraw to draft, approve while withdrawable, reopenable board cancel, board move); if nobody can put it back, confirm first (delete conversation, one-step revert, remove server listing its queued prompts, delete phone Ubuntu with typed name, remove worktree/workspace with changes with typed name, stop a task mid-work, clear diagnostics or drafts, revoke a saved permission, disconnect a provider, public share). Never both; never confirm a harmless act; never a destructive swipe without Undo; the same act gets the same model from every door.

Destructive styling: error colour only for acts that lose data or end running work; never primary on a screen (only inside a destructive/stop/discard KitConfirmSheet); never beside a frequent action (KitActionBlock stacks it); last in row menus after a divider; label is a verb naming the thing; icon trash/stop/edit-off in error tone, never "?"; cancel words Keep running / Keep editing / Cancel.

One details fold: all technical values go into one KitDetailsFold, last and collapsed, each value once, copyable, LTR; engine words, ids, paths and ports only there; a standalone raw error uses showKitTechnicalDetails, never an AlertDialog.

One log panel: every process output is a KitLogPanel, folded under Details unless the page exists for that log; one panel per source; follows, polls only while visible, redacted, error tone for errors only.

One needs-you marker: one attention source counted once per request across servers, shown only through KitNeedsYou mark/span/badge with its word; same words on tab, row, server row, header and notification; answered anywhere clears everywhere.

One container per task: screen = place, KitSheet = choice/short task/confirmation, KitDialog = short text entry or blocking alert, showKitUndo = done-with-undo, KitStatusLine = condition on a working screen, KitNotice = message about one part.
No sheet on a sheet: a confirmation or choice raised inside a KitSheet replaces its content in place.
Feedback in place: copy shows its check on the button, a write shows its KitReceipt where it was made, a failure shows a KitNotice on that part; the snackbar is only for Undo.
Honest waiting lives in the kit: waiting parts take since and escalate after 8 s by themselves; a disabled control always carries a visible reason; a button never shows lasting status.

Technical text and secrets: every value the app did not write is rendered by a kit part that isolates it LTR and makes it copyable; secrets enter only through KitField.secret and are never displayed again, prefilled, copied, logged or shown in details or code.
Motion and haptics: only KitMotion durations and curves, nothing moves under KitMotion.reduced, no layout animation in scrolling lists; haptics only send, done and commit through KitHaptics.
Entry rule: a part joins the kit when two or more pages need it; single-use widgets stay in their module, built from kit parts and covered by the same raw-widget gates.

gates.name: Still under reduced motion
gates.checks: Every part under MediaQuery(disableAnimations: true) and under Effects Animations: Off settles after one pump() with no running ticker; KitStatusMark shows its still dot under Effects Off (fails today).

gates.name: Behaviour contracts per part
gates.checks: KitConfirmSheet: false on back, swipe and cancel; typed name enables confirm only on exact match; commit haptic only for stop/destructive/discard and never with Vibration off; confirm raised from a KitSheet adds no route. KitUndo: one at a time, persists under accessibleNavigation, failure shows a notice. KitRequestCard: answered state announced once; answering elsewhere closes its sheet via RequestRoutes and leaves the receipt. KitStateView/KitStatusLine/KitReceipt: escalate after 8 s with fake async. KitIconButton.copy: clipboard set, "Copied" announced, no SnackBar. KitLogPanel: follows unless scrolled up; no polling off screen. KitChoiceList.single: one tap, one callback. KitField.secret: asserts empty controller, obscured, no suggestions.

gates.name: Drafts survive and are swept
gates.checks: Every showKitSheet with a KitDraft: type, swipe down, reopen, text kept; back and force-restart keep it; keys are oc.draft.<target>.<profileId> and ProfileStore.profileScopedPreferenceKeys removes them on profile deletion (mock the secure-storage channel per AGENTS.md).

gates.name: Copy rules
gates.checks: showKitConfirm titles end with "?"; confirm labels are never OK, Yes, Continue or Confirm; cancel labels match the kind; contradiction pairs (Working + stopped, Paused + idle, Connected + reconnecting) never co-occur on a golden fixture; engine words only inside KitDetailsFold/KitLogPanel/KitCodeBlock.

gates.name: Redaction through every technical part
gates.checks: Fake provider keys and bearer tokens fed through KitLogPanel, KitDetailsFold, KitCodeBlock, KitIconButton.copy, diagnostics and the report preview never appear in rendered text, clipboard or test output.

gates.name: Map stays true
